trap.label: passiva impessoal
trap.wrong: It thinks that the cave contains gold.
trap.right: The cave is thought to contain gold.
trap.why: Português usa “pensa-se”/“dizem que”; inglês usa passiva impessoal, nunca “It thinks”.

opts: It is believed to be safe.
I know the tomb contains gold.
The tomb is thought to contain gold.

mcq.q: The wall is said **___** built in 1200.

fix.wrong: It is thought that to contain gold.
fix.right: It is thought to contain gold.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com passiva impessoal: “People believe the site is ancient.”
rewrite.answer: The site is believed to be ancient.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com “It is said that”: “The tomb is said to be cursed.”
rewrite.answer: It is said that the tomb is cursed.

rewrite.prompt: Inicie com “According to”: “The report says it fell.”
rewrite.answer: According to the report, it fell.
